sample_unit: cataract surgery complication scenarios (each answered by 7 surgeons and a chatbot)

links.outcome: Readability grade level of chatbot versus surgeon patient-counselling responses
links.effect: Surgeons' readability score 10.64 was significantly less complex than chatbot's 12.54 (p < 0.001); chatbot answers were longer and more detailed.
links.quote: The readability scores for the surgeons (10.64) were significantly less complex than the chatbot (12.54) (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM-generated patient communication instructions against human surgeons across 10 cataract surgery complication scenarios using readability, accuracy, completeness, and empathy scores.
